description: Upload a local image file or an HTTPS image to Shopify Files, wait for processing, and return its CDN URL (check it later with shopify_get resource uploaded_image). Defaults to dryRun:true, which previews the upload without sending anything.

dryRun.description: True (the default) returns a before/after preview without changing anything in Shopify. Pass false, after the user authorizes this store and exact change, to apply it; the tool then reads the result back.

name: shopify_upload_image
